---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
# uploading data
install.packages("readr")
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

health <- read_csv("apple_health_records.csv")

view(health)
```
```{r}
# see which types of health data are available
health |>
  count(type, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# calculate daily step counts
steps_daily <- health |>
  filter(type == "HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(startDate), value = as.numeric(value)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(steps = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = wday(date, label = TRUE, week_start = 1),
    day_type = if_else(
      day_of_week %in% c("Sat", "Sun"),
      "Weekend",
      "Weekday"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# examine the resulting dataset
summary(steps_daily)
```

```{r}
# initial visualization 
ggplot(steps_daily, aes(x = date, y = steps)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "My Daily Step Count Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Steps per Day",
    caption = "Source: Personal Apple Health export"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# multivariate visualization 
ggplot(steps_daily, aes(x = day_of_week, y = steps)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = day_type)) +
  labs(
    title = "Walking Distance based on Weekday vs. Weekend",
    subtitle = "Distribution of daily steps by day of the week",
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Total Steps per Day",
    fill = "Day Type",
    caption = "Source: Personal Apple Health export"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
